column4: THE CARTEL BOSS / WAS A COP

HOW A NEW CARTEL / ANNOUNCED ITSELF
HE RAN A CARTEL / LIKE A COMPANY
THEY TRIED TO ARREST HIM / THE CITY STOPPED
HUGS, NOT BULLETS / DID IT WORK?
A JUDGE. A POLICE CHIEF. / THE MESSAGE
A SECRET DEAL WITH / EL CHAPO'S SONS
THE LAST TWO HOURS / OF EL MENCHO
